name: Salmon with Cauliflower Rice, Carrots, Beets & Cilantro-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium beets
1 medium head cauliflower
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro
4 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

While the beets are roasting, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower and place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, garlic, green onion, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower rice is tender, about 5 minutes. Cover and remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the cauliflower rice is cooking, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; coat both sides with oil and season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg salmon fillet
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir the beets, and push to one side. Place salmon on the other side of the baking sheet and return to the oven. Bake until salmon is cooked through and beets are tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer half to a blender (place remaining cilantro in the reserved bowl and set aside).

Peel additional garlic; add to the blender along with water, tahini, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
¼ cup water
3 tbsp tahini
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the remaining cilantro.
Add cauliflower rice to the bowl and stir to combine.
To serve, divide the cauliflower rice mixture between plates; top with roasted beets, salmon, and cilantro-tahini sauce. Enjoy!
